verification_note: Empirical gate: odin build app green; tools/lint.sh 5/5 green; odin test core 126/126; tools/harness.sh run 16/16 demos green; tools/harness.sh preview-check 7/7 green; 70/70 golden files byte-identical to baseline 69fc2e5 (sha256); zero core/ files in the diff; LOG_VERSION untouched; no new commands.

findings.title: Per-drag-frame preview rebuild leaks temp-arena memory cumulatively (the app never free_alls)
findings.evidence: core/routing.odin:127-130: `dist := make([]i32, int(n), context.temp_allocator)` / `settled := make([]bool, int(n), context.temp_allocator)` / `seen := make([]bool, int(n), context.temp_allocator)` / `min_cost := make([]i32, int(n), context.temp_allocator)` — 4 arrays per rebuild; assist.odin calls `pp.routing_rebuild(&s.rt, &s.topo, cat)` every drag move frame; app/main.odin has NO free_all (grep: free_all appears only in core tests + harness).
findings.detail: The app is arena-free (ODN-18 [LATER]); routing_rebuild's 4 temp arrays + the 'route N' aprintf accumulate on the default temp allocator every frame of a drag — unbounded across a session of heavy dragging.
findings.recommended_fix: Either cache rebuild scratch in Preview_Scratch or add a per-frame temp arena with free_all once (harness pattern); note in ODN-18.

findings.title: A parallel-pipe routing no-op ON the winning path still fires the preview (dag_has_edge is pair membership only)
findings.location: app/render/assist.odin:373-381 (dag_has_edge); harness/assist_check.odin S7 pins only the UPSTREAM case
findings.evidence: assist.odin: `dag_has_edge :: proc(out: ^Route_Preview, a, b: u32) -> bool { for e in out.edges { if (e.u == a && e.v == b) || (e.u == b && e.v == a) { return true } } return false }` — pure pair membership; a second pipe on an existing bundle leaves min edge cost (and the table) unchanged, yet the pair is in the DAG -> preview fires with a route number for a draw that changes nothing. The I/O matrix row S7 says 'no glow, no route number for a no-op draw' — the harness's S7 only covers the pair-UPSTREAM case.
findings.detail: Spec intent: 'no packet affected -> no glow, no number' (I/O matrix). A parallel-pipe draw on the winning path affects no routing, but previews anyway — a misleading 'route N' for a redundant pipe.
findings.recommended_fix: Compare the what-if table's DAG cost/path against the pre-draw DAG; suppress the preview when the winning path is unchanged (or document the no-op preview as intended).

findings.title: S5 does not pin the E29 mid-flight rule — the on_edge/heading start is indistinguishable from at_node
findings.location: harness/assist_check.odin S5 (cand := pp.Cmd_Draw_Pipe{1, 3, wide} with no 3-4 pipe drawn); app/render/assist.odin preview_compute start selection
findings.evidence: S5 pre-draws only 0-1, 1-2, 2-4 and the candidate {1,3,wide} — node 3 has no onward pipe, so the DAG from EITHER start node 0 (at_node) or node 1 (heading) excludes the candidate; the scenario cannot distinguish `start := p.at_node` from `start = p.heading`. The code is correct (E29: re-decide at heading), but the test that claims to pin it does not.
findings.detail: The mid-flight re-decision branch in preview_compute has zero discriminating coverage — a regression to at_node would pass 7/7.
findings.recommended_fix: Redraw S5 so the candidate completes a route reachable from at_node but not from heading (or vice versa); assert the heading-based outcome.

findings.title: The app-layer surfaces (R3 glow lifecycle, two-buffer copy, T toggle, nudge) have zero automated pins
findings.location: app/main.odin:172-189 (render gate), 393-417 (commit path), 262-277 (T toggle) — no app test file exists
findings.evidence: ls app/*_test* -> none; the harness drives ONLY rnd.preview_compute (assist_check.odin); the round's own field notes record a HIGH-severity glow-buffer bug (shared-buffer first cut rendering a never-committed path) that was caught by review, not by a test — and the fix (two buffers + glow_gen gate) is still unpinned.
findings.detail: A broken glow gate (e.g. glow_gen captured pre-apply), a toggle that doesn't cycle, or a nudge that repeats would ship green — every one of the four acceptance surfaces is only manually verified.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a headless app-level pin (or extend preview-check) exercising commit->glow_gen gate, T cycling, nudge latch, and the cancel-never-corrupts-glow property.

findings.title: The preview-vs-sim cost cross-check uses a mirrored pricing scan (triplicated min-bundle-cost) — total cost is anchored only for fixture topologies
findings.evidence: assist.odin: `min_bundle_cost :: proc(...) { best := i32(1) << 30; for pi ... { c := cat.pipe_tiers[t.pipe_tier[pi]].cost; if c < best { best = c } } return best }` and the harness's `check_min_cost` is a byte-for-byte copy — the harness compares preview cost vs sim cost computed by the SAME scan, so a systematic pricing error would pass both; only the literal pins (want 20/10/15) anchor the fixtures.
findings.detail: Three copies of the same edge-pricing rule with no shared accessor; the cross-check is partially self-referential for non-fixture topologies.
findings.recommended_fix: Export the min-bundle-cost scan from core (the table's pass-1 logic) and have both the preview and the check consume it; keep the literal pins.

findings.title: topology_clone_into hand-copies an explicit field list — a future Topology field missed here would silently diverge the preview
findings.evidence: Verified complete TODAY: all 17 Topology fields (node_alive/id/kind/role/type/pos/next_node_id, pipe_alive/id/a/b/tier/span/weights/lane_over/next_pipe_id, gen) are copied. The hazard is forward-looking: no compile-time completeness check.
findings.detail: No present defect — completeness verified against core/topology.odin. A later slice adding a field without updating the clone list would silently zero/stale it in the what-if.
findings.recommended_fix: A comment in core/topology.odin beside the struct, or a clone shared with the core (ODN-18 arena note), so future fields are caught.

findings.title: draws_since_nudge counts every successful commit, not 'N successful draws in Full mode'
findings.evidence: `app.draws_since_nudge += 1` runs unconditionally on every commit; the nudge condition requires assist_mode == .Full at fire time. A player with draws spent in Glow_Only/Off can trigger the nudge after fewer than N Full-mode draws.
findings.detail: Minor deviation from the I/O matrix's 'N successful draws, mode Full, nudge unseen' trigger wording.
findings.recommended_fix: Increment only when assist_mode == .Full, or reword the spec to 'N successful draws'.

findings.title: A commit with no live preview truncates a still-running R3 glow (glow_until = 0) and leaves the stale glow buffer in place
findings.evidence: `if app.preview_live && app.preview.ok { ... } else { app.glow_until = 0 }` — a dead-end/no-op commit extinguishes the previous draw's glow mid-window; glow.ok stays true with the old DAG (harmless: never rendered with glow_until 0, released at next run start).
findings.detail: Defensible design (each commit refocuses the glow) but a literal read of R3 ('keeps glowing for glow_ticks') is truncated by a subsequent no-preview commit.
findings.recommended_fix: Either let the old glow run its window, or add a comment naming the truncation as intended.

findings.title: Any active drag blanks the committed R3 glow — even a drag with no valid candidate
findings.evidence: The gate renders the preview only when `app.preview_live && app.preview.ok && app.drag.active`, and the committed glow only when `!app.drag.active` — an unsnapped/invalid drag hides the running glow for the whole drag (flicker), then it returns on release.
findings.detail: Cosmetic flicker during the glow window; the preview-replaces-glow structure is deliberate.
findings.recommended_fix: Fall back to the committed glow while `drag.active && !preview.ok` (low priority).

findings.title: The graduation nudge persists frozen on the Game_Over screen where its dismiss key (T) is dead
findings.location: app/main.odin:759 (nudge draw in draw_hud) + 252-258 (Game_Over early return before the T handler)
findings.evidence: handle_input returns early for Game_Over (only R/ENTER restart) BEFORE the T toggle; draw_hud still draws the nudge while `app.nudge_until > 0 && app.tick <= app.nudge_until` — a nudge fired just before game-over lingers with no way to dismiss until restart.
findings.detail: Minor UX nit on the frozen end screen.
findings.recommended_fix: Gate the nudge draw to app.mode == .Run, or clear nudge_until on game-over.

findings.title: Graduation N lives in data/assist.json, not balance.json — deviation documented in-spec and flagged for the human; rationale verified sound
findings.evidence: The spec's Boundaries section: 'Deviation from the briefing's "N in balance.json": balance.json folds every byte into cat.hash -> any field addition re-blesses ALL goldens (violates acceptance 5, STRICT)... Flagged for the human; a future legitimate re-bless can move it.' Fallback defaults exist and malformed values are validated (n > 0; g/t >= 0).
findings.detail: Pre-accepted by the lens-guards (assist.json is an allowed cosmetic-class ODN-5 surface). Keep on the human's radar for the next re-bless window.
findings.recommended_fix: None now — move to balance.json at the next legitimate golden re-bless.

findings.title: The mutation-test negative control (corrupt a cost -> preview-check goes red) is a manual local run, not committed
findings.evidence: The CI step comment: 'The negative control is a local run; CI pins the green path.' — no committed negative pin.
findings.detail: The cross-check has no committed negative control (a deliberately-diverged preview must fail).
findings.recommended_fix: Commit a drift-style negative pin (corrupt a tier cost, expect FAIL) alongside the drift-check pattern.

rejected.title: R3 glow dies one frame after commit (glow_gen pre-apply)
rejected.reason: False: the commit path applies the edit via the ODN-2 fast path BEFORE capturing glow_gen — `pp.topology_apply_edit(...)` runs first in the same if-block, so app.state.topology.gen is already POST-apply; the render gate `gen == glow_gen` holds for the full window. Manual trace + code read confirmed.

rejected.reason: Speculative 'what if' with no actual mismatch: core/flow.odin:707 calls `ecmp_pick(p.src, p.dst, u8(p.class), p.id, count)` — byte-identical to the harness's call in packet_path_matches. No divergence exists.

rejected.title: fmt brace-collision garbles preview-check FAIL diagnostics
rejected.reason: False: Odin's fmt is printf-style (%v verbs); curly braces in `fmt.aprintf("...want {0-1,1-2}", ...)` are literal text, not format specifiers. No collision exists.
